defaultValue:
Destroyed Omega ships can drop the Omega core that commanded them. Bigger ships drop it more often, the same way vanilla AI cores work: a destroyer counts twice, a cruiser three times and a capital four times.

If Astral Ascension is installed, it keeps control of Omega core drops and these two settings do nothing.

fieldDescription: Destroyed Omega ships can drop their Omega core. Switch off to make Omega cores unobtainable again.
Chance that a destroyed Omega frigate drops its core. Destroyers, cruisers and capitals multiply it by 2, 3 and 4.
